subject.title: [Feature]: Support configurable request labels for Gemini API calls (GCP billing tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw expose Google/Vertex request labels as a public provider config surface, and what schema, provider scope, and privacy/cardinality limits should it use?
rationale: This expands the public provider config contract and sends operator metadata to Google billing systems, so code inspection cannot choose the permanent product policy.

options.title: Approve bounded Vertex labels
options.body: Expose a validated label map for Google Vertex generateContent requests only, with documented GCP constraints and tests.

options.title: Use existing transport knobs
options.body: Decline a first-class field unless existing headers, params, proxy, or provider request surfaces can satisfy billing attribution safely.

options.title: Defer metadata design
options.body: Keep this as product backlog until OpenClaw has a broader cross-provider request-metadata policy.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Vertex labels
recommendation.body: Expose a validated label map for Google Vertex generateContent requests only, with documented GCP constraints and tests.
